scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title song before reporter Bianbian sits down with PR director Stella at Xingtian.

scenes.title: Questions Declined
scenes.summary: Entertainment reporter Bianbian interviews PR director Stella about how Xingtian turned its feud with Xin Huimei around, and Stella coolly invokes her contractual right to decline his probing question as Bu Xiaogu serves coffee.

scenes.title: Praise Instead of Complaints
scenes.summary: At DTS's two-month review meeting, Qin Xiao invites feedback while Kaiwen's prior persuasion leads the two commentators to apologise for Star Night and praise Chun Yuqiao's production standards, provoking a rival executive.

scenes.title: Playing Luo Lin's Recording
scenes.summary: A rival Xingtian executive plays a secret phone recording from ME host Luo Lin to attack Chun Yuqiao, inadvertently infuriating the DTS network director because Luo Lin has repeatedly snubbed DTS.

scenes.title: Recognising the Finale Night Producer
scenes.summary: Thanking Bu Xiaogu for the coffee, Bianbian recognises her from the night Li Mingji collapsed onstage, guesses Xingtian hid her in administration to protect her, and invites her for an after-work drink.

scenes.title: Overtime Already at Its Limit
scenes.summary: When DTS strips Unit Two of the weekly talk show and asks Chun Yuqiao to take full control, Yuqiao declines because Unit One's overtime is already at its limit, while Kaiwen and Xingzi discuss the rival executive's blunder.
scenes.location: conference room and Unit One office

scenes.title: Summoned by the Chairwoman's Office
scenes.summary: Rival department heads worry about taking a loss as the chairwoman's office summons all directors to a formal meeting following DTS's complaint.

scenes.title: Master's Degrees and Marketing Deals
scenes.summary: Over evening drinks, Bu Xiaogu parries Bianbian's questions about Xingtian's internal rivalries, bonds with him as a fellow master's graduate, and learns Lutiao News really wants Xingtian's marketing contract.

scenes.title: Taking Full Responsibility Alone
scenes.summary: When Bianbian guesses that Manta Ray shielded her after the Li Mingji incident, Bu Xiaogu insists the mistake was hers alone and vows to leave the industry before letting Chun Yuqiao take any blame.

scenes.title: Setting Up the All-Directors Hall
scenes.summary: Assigned to prepare the hall for tomorrow's all-directors meeting and worried Bianbian will side with Stella against Chun Yuqiao, Bu Xiaogu works late preparing for what she fears is her final day before greeting Kaiwen.

scenes.title: Proposing the Production Merger
scenes.summary: At the all-directors meeting, the chairwoman announces a board resolution merging all four production units under Chun Yuqiao as chief content officer and calls for an executive vote when rivals object.

scenes.title: Bianbian's Unexpected Gesture of Loyalty
scenes.summary: In a flashback during the vote, Bianbian uses PR's earlier leak to persuade Stella to back Chun Yuqiao, then phones Kaiwen to say Xiaogu's loyalty inspired him to befriend genuinely loyal people.

scenes.title: Adopting the Chief Content Officer System
scenes.summary: Backed by Talent, PR, Unit One, and the chairwoman's decisive vote, Xingtian formally launches the chief content officer system using Unit One's management standards as the company blueprint.

scenes.title: Transferred to Assistant Planner
scenes.summary: After Kaiwen pledges Unit One's support, Chun Yuqiao tells the chairwoman that external DTS supervision can help drive reform, Kaiwen tries to calm a bitter rival, and Bu Xiaogu is officially promoted to assistant planner.
scenes.location: conference hall, car, and admin desk

scenes.title: Drinking to Make Peace
scenes.summary: Despite severe stomach trouble, Chun Yuqiao visits his rival unit directors at night to apologise sincerely and drinks toast after toast while Kaiwen desperately tries to take the glasses for him.

scenes.title: What Wielding Power Really Costs
scenes.summary: Finding Chun Yuqiao collapsed outside in pain, Bu Xiaogu rushes him to hospital, recalls teasing him earlier about wielding total power, and tells Qin Xiao on the phone that she has fallen in love with him.

scenes.title: Copycat Shows on Television
scenes.summary: On air, host Wen Simo discusses the wave of copycat television shows, jokes that viewers struggle to tell Twelve Singers apart from ME's Supernova, and quips that his honesty might cost him his monthly bonus.

scenes.title: Pulling Ahead of Supernova
scenes.summary: Watching the broadcast in the office, Xingzi and Kaiwen debate how Twelve Singers can change its competition rules to pull ahead of ME's Supernova while Kaiwen pokes fun at Wen Simo's hair gel.

scenes.title: Whose Duty Is Blocking Drinks?
scenes.summary: Xingzi scolds Kaiwen for failing to block Chun Yuqiao's drinks the night before, sparking a comical office spat over Kaiwen's forty-minute hairstyle right before the chairwoman walks in.

scenes.title: Covering for the Chairwoman's Brother
scenes.summary: When the chairwoman demands to know why Chun Yuqiao suffered alcohol-induced stomach bleeding, Kaiwen blames his own friends to spare her brother, then coldly lists Yuqiao's emergency treatments afterward.

scenes.title: Colleagues at a Garden Teahouse
scenes.summary: Ignoring trailing paparazzi after her break, Xin Huimei meets friend Wen Simo at a classical garden teahouse and learns he has been assigned to host Xingtian's revamped weekly talk show.

scenes.title: Declining to Put His Name on the Credits
scenes.summary: After Qin Xiao and DTS praise the revamped talk-show plan hosted by Wen Simo and suggest co-producing it with Unit Two's head, Kaiwen announces that Chun Yuqiao refuses joint credits and will leave his name off.
